# Pivotal Consulting Group

> Premium performance marketing consultancy delivering measurable results for enterprise B2B and DTC brands with $150K+ monthly ad spend. Former Google/Amazon leaders bringing accountability and data-driven strategies.

Pivotal Consulting Group (PCG) specializes in Google Ads, paid social, analytics, and AI-powered marketing optimization. Based in Kansas City and Ann Arbor, we've managed $250M+ in ad spend with an average 2.3x ROAS improvement and 34% CAC reduction. Our approach combines enterprise-level expertise with hands-on accountability—we treat your budget like our own.

## Core Services

- [Google Ads & YouTube Management](https://www.pivotal-consulting-group.com/services/google-ads): Expert Google Ads management that drives scalable, profitable growth. From search campaigns to YouTube advertising, we engineer campaigns that maximize ROI and scale efficiently.
- [Meta & LinkedIn Advertising](https://www.pivotal-consulting-group.com/services/meta-linkedin-ads): Strategic social media advertising across Meta and LinkedIn platforms. Drive engagement, conversions, and business growth with data-driven campaign management.
- [Analytics & Measurement](https://www.pivotal-consulting-group.com/services/analytics-measurement): Build reliable analytics foundations with advanced measurement strategies. From GA4 implementation to custom attribution modeling, ensure your marketing decisions are based on accurate data.
- [AI & Future-Ready Strategy](https://www.pivotal-consulting-group.com/services/ai-strategy): Stay ahead of the AI revolution in marketing. From search optimization to conversational commerce preparation, ensure your brand remains visible in AI-driven discovery.
